properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated December 23, [1933], on stationery from the Metropole Hotel in Shanghai; includes description of dinner party for [Major Edward and Mrs.] Howard; includes description of pay raises provided by Pan American Airways; progress on the airport hangar construction at Lungchow [Longzhou] and on negotiations for the Longzhou - Canton [Guangzho] route; mentions Mr. [Juan] Trippe, Miss Labne, Mr. [P.D.C.] Ball, Mr. Dai [Enki], the minister of communications [Chu Chia-hua], Max Polin.
